name: TEST-MedBlend Pro 100mg/50mg/25mg/mL
dosage_instructions: Inject 1 mL (100 units) subcutaneously once daily in the morning on an empty stomach.
detailed_description:
Active Ingredients (per 1 mL):
• Levocarnitine (L-Carnitine) — 100 mg/mL
• Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) — 50 mg/mL
• Chromium Picolinate — 25 mg/mL
• Thiamine (Vitamin B1) — 10 mg/mL

A comprehensive metabolic support injection combining amino acids and essential vitamins to promote fat metabolism, energy production, and blood sugar regulation.
